osfo_file_normalizing_state.name: osfo_file_normalizing_state
osfo_file_normalizing_state.value: ("osfo_files"."state" = 'normalizing' AND "osfo_files"."normalization_claimed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("osfo_files"."state" != 'normalizing' AND "osfo_files"."normalization_claimed_at" IS NULL)

osfo_file_deleted_state.name: osfo_file_deleted_state
osfo_file_deleted_state.value: ("osfo_files"."state" = 'deleted' AND "osfo_files"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("osfo_files"."state" != 'deleted' AND "osfo_files"."deleted_at" IS NULL)

osfo_memory_provider_configuration_compl.name: osfo_memory_provider_configuration_completion
osfo_memory_provider_configuration_compl.value: ("osfo_memory_provider_configuration"."status" = 'configured' AND "osfo_memory_provider_configuration"."configured_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("osfo_memory_provider_configuration"."status" = 'pending' AND "osfo_memory_provider_configuration"."configured_at" IS NULL)

osfo_personal_skill_learning_claim.name: osfo_personal_skill_learning_claim
osfo_personal_skill_learning_claim.value: ("osfo_personal_skill_learning_candidates"."status" = 'claimed' AND "osfo_personal_skill_learning_candidates"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "osfo_personal_skill_learning_candidates"."claim_expires_at_epoch_millis" IS NOT NULL) OR ("osfo_personal_skill_learning_candidates"."status" != 'claimed' AND "osfo_personal_skill_learning_candidates"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "osfo_personal_skill_learning_candidates"."claim_expires_at_epoch_millis" IS NULL)

osfo_qualification_admission_submission.name: osfo_qualification_admission_submission
osfo_qualification_admission_submission.value: ("osfo_qualification_admissions"."admission_decision" = 'accepted' AND "osfo_qualification_admissions"."think_submission_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("osfo_qualification_admissions"."admission_decision" != 'accepted' AND "osfo_qualification_admissions"."think_submission_id" IS NULL)

osfo_reminder_occurrence_disposition.name: osfo_reminder_occurrence_disposition
osfo_reminder_occurrence_disposition.value: (("osfo_reminder_occurrences"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL) + ("osfo_reminder_occurrences"."blocked_at" IS NOT NULL) + ("osfo_reminder_occurrences"."canceled_at" IS NOT NULL)) = 1

osfo_reminder_occurrence_delivery.name: osfo_reminder_occurrence_delivery
osfo_reminder_occurrence_delivery.value: ("osfo_reminder_occurrences"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."channel_link_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("osfo_reminder_occurrences"."committed_at" IS NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."channel_link_id" IS NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."accounting_recorded_at" IS NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."wakeup_requested_at" IS NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."wakeup_prompted_at" IS NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."exposed_at" IS NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."think_presented_at" IS NULL)

osfo_reminder_occurrence_think_presentat.name: osfo_reminder_occurrence_think_presentation
osfo_reminder_occurrence_think_presentat.value: ("osfo_reminder_occurrences"."think_presented_at" IS NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."think_submission_id" IS NULL) OR ("osfo_reminder_occurrences"."think_presented_at" IS NOT NULL AND "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."think_submission_id" IS NOT NULL)

osfo_reminder_occurrence_source_revocati.name: osfo_reminder_occurrence_source_revocation
osfo_reminder_occurrence_source_revocati.value: "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."source_revoked_at" IS NULL OR "osfo_reminder_occurrences"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL

osfo_reminder_due_state.name: osfo_reminder_due_state
osfo_reminder_due_state.value: ("osfo_reminders"."state" IN ('active', 'paused') AND "osfo_reminders"."next_due_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("osfo_reminders"."state" IN ('canceled', 'completed') AND "osfo_reminders"."next_due_at" IS NULL)

osfo_reminder_schedule_binding.name: osfo_reminder_schedule_binding
osfo_reminder_schedule_binding.value: ("osfo_reminders"."scheduler_id" IS NULL AND "osfo_reminders"."callback_capability" IS NULL) OR ("osfo_reminders"."scheduler_id" IS NOT NULL AND "osfo_reminders"."callback_capability" IS NOT NULL)

osfo_web_operation_completion.name: osfo_web_operation_completion
osfo_web_operation_completion.value: ("osfo_web_operations"."status" = 'completed' AND "osfo_web_operations"."result_json" IS NOT NULL) OR ("osfo_web_operations"."status" = 'pending' AND "osfo_web_operations"."result_json" IS NULL)
